faqs.q: US Navy stockless anchor compared with the Spek stockless anchor?
faqs.a: The US Navy pattern has no published size table, so we quote it on request. The [Spek stockless anchor](/p/spek-stockless-anchor) has a full size table. Choose per your drawing.

faqs.q: Do you stock the US Navy stockless anchor, and how do I request a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the US Navy stockless anchor in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the sizes and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is the welded Pool anchor and what sizes does it come in?
faqs.a: The welded Pool anchor is a fabricated Pool-pattern anchor in 63 sizes from 60 kg to 17,260 kg, for vessels, buoys and moorings. Each size has its own Indus part number, and the table gives the lettered dimensions.

faqs.q: How do I read the Indus part number on the welded Pool anchor?
faqs.a: In IH-LR-AN-POOLW-60KG, the suffix 60KG is the 60 kg size, and IH-LR-AN-POOLW-17260KG ends in 17260KG for 17260 kg. Each mass has its own part number.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the welded Pool anchor come in?
faqs.a: The size table lists 63 rows, from 60 kg to 17260 kg. Each row gives its mass and the dimensions the lettered dimensions of the drawing, and has its own Indus part number.

faqs.q: How do I choose the mass of the welded Pool anchor?
faqs.a: Specify the anchor by type and weight, and state any classification society certificate the vessel needs. Mass is sized from the vessel's equipment number under class rules, as the welded Pool anchor is for vessels, buoys and moorings; see the equipment number guide.

faqs.q: What holding power or proof load does the welded Pool anchor have?
faqs.a: No holding power or proof load is published for the welded Pool anchor in the facts we hold, so we do not quote one here. Tell us the vessel and duty and we confirm the rating with the quotation; see [anchor proof load testing](/blog/anchor-proof-load-testing) for how anchors are tested.

faqs.q: What is the welded Pool anchor made from?
faqs.a: The facts we hold give no material or finish for the welded Pool anchor, so confirm them on the quotation, and say if the vessel needs a particular steel or coating. Confirm the finish for marine service, and ask us if you need a different coating on the welded Pool anchor.

faqs.q: Which standard or certificate applies to the welded Pool anchor?
faqs.a: Each consignment of the welded Pool anchor ships with the manufacturer's test certificate. If your vessel needs a classification-society certificate, state it on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What anchor chain and shackles go with the welded Pool anchor?
faqs.a: The welded Pool anchor is shackled to anchor chain of a grade matched to the vessel. Read the guide to [anchor chain grades U1, U2 and U3](/blog/anchor-chain-grades-u1-u2-u3) for stud link, studless and the shackles that join them, and see the [Anchor Handling Chasers shelf](/c/anchor-handling-chasers) for the handling gear.

faqs.q: What should I check before supplying a welded Pool anchor?
faqs.a: Before you ship or fit the welded Pool anchor, check the mass against the class requirement and confirm the test certificate you need. See anchor proof load testing for test loads by anchor mass, and the Marine Anchors shelf for related anchors.

faqs.q: Where is the welded Pool anchor used?
faqs.a: Welded Pool anchors are used on vessels, buoys and moorings. See the [equipment number guide](/blog/equipment-number-anchor-chain-sizing). Send the mass you need for the welded Pool anchor and any class requirement and we confirm the size.

faqs.q: Welded Pool anchor compared with the Pool anchor Type N?
faqs.a: The welded Pool anchor is listed in 63 sizes to 17,260 kg. The [Pool anchor Type N](/p/pool-anchor-type-n) is listed in 52 sizes. Choose per the drawing.

faqs.q: Do you stock the welded Pool anchor, and how do I request a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes, the welded Pool anchor is held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and ships worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the masses and quantities via [our contact page](/contact).
